scientific_scope_status: For a known irreducible endpoint chain and supplied nonnegative quartic box, the accepted finite-temperature construction selects n independent uniform shifts from any 3n-2 distinct positive candidates. A finite Gaussian-moment forward compiler supplies the conditional receiver; the executed four-node star is separately frame-qualified, not treated as a chain.
